item.title: 50th Anniversary Celebration Now Online
item.description: The 50th Anniversary Celebration is now online. Relive the night's events on the Celebrating 50 Years of Impact page on the LeavePlus website.

item.title: Coffee with an Exec: Craig's Highlights
item.description: CEO Craig Bell met six staff last week. The new portal can't be rolled back after launch, so getting it right comes first. Elevate is moving from squads to one shared product.

item.title: Bledisloe Cup: All Blacks Beat Wallabies 50-19
item.description: The All Blacks led 17-14 at half-time at Eden Park, then scored twice in six minutes after a Wallabies obstruction penalty and pulled away to retain the Cup. Game two is next week.

item.title: Bathurst 1000: Kostecki Wins as De Pasquale Runs Dry
item.description: Anton De Pasquale of Team 18 left the final pitstop with a 10-second lead but ran out of fuel on the last lap. Brodie Kostecki of Dick Johnson Racing drove past to win.

item.title: Business Transformation Committee - Tue 13 Oct
item.description: The committee meets on Tuesday 13 October to review Project Elevate's progress.

item.title: Executive Ask Us Anything - Wed 14 Oct 11:30am
item.description: Craig Bell and Catryn Tuckwell, Chief Legal & Compliance Officer, host in the L5 breakout space. Submit questions beforehand via Menti or on the day. All questions stay anonymous.

item.title: National Coming Out Day - Sun 11 Oct
item.description: Sunday 11 October was National Coming Out Day. Coming out for the first time can be a momentous step, and for many of us it continues throughout life.

item.title: National Carers Week - 11-17 Oct
item.description: More than 3 million Australians give unpaid care to family or friends. This year's theme, Care for a carer: Making carers visible, asks us to recognise and support carers around us.

item.title: West Gate Bridge Memorial - Thu 15 Oct 11:30am
item.description: Marking 56 years since the bridge collapse, people gather under the bridge on Douglas Parade, Spotswood. The office pool car takes up to 5 staff. Watch for the EOI email.

item.title: Christmas Party - RSVP by Fri 16 Oct
item.description: The Christmas Party is on Friday 27 November and catering needs final numbers by Friday 16 October. RSVP to the calendar reminder if you haven't already.

item.title: Health & Safety Hub Has a New Look
item.description: Check the refreshed hub for First Aid and OHS information, plus resources from our Ergonomic Champions and Mental Health First Aiders.

item.title: Facilities: Please Clean Up After Yourself
item.description: We've had complaints about the toilets and dirty dishes left in kitchenette sinks. Toilets get a midday clean, but everyone needs to clean up after themselves in all amenities.

item.title: Respect Personal Belongings
item.description: Please don't go through, move or interfere with anyone's belongings without their permission. If you see this happening, let your Team Leader know.

item.title: Christmas Leave 2026: Plan Ahead
item.description: A reminder to plan for your Christmas leave. See the post IMPORTANT: Christmas Leave 2026 on CoINVEST News for how to plan.

item.title: EOI: Acknowledgement of Country at Town Hall
item.description: Interested in presenting the Acknowledgement of Country at a Town Hall? Let Matt Young know or sign up via the EOI form on Teams.

item.title: New Starter: Diana Lautenbach, Cyber Security Fraud & Identity Engineer
item.description: Diana started on Monday 12 October. Please join us in welcoming her to the LeavePlus team.

item.title: Benefit Spotlight: Professional Development
item.description: Eligible permanent employees can get support for training, new skills, multi-skilling and career development, building internal career options and transferable skills.

item.title: Catch Up on Town Hall Presentations
item.description: Missed a Town Hall? All presentations are available on The Hub.

item.title: Looking for a New Role? Check Team Tailor
item.description: Current vacancies: Consultant Member Support 2A and Consultant Member Response 2A, both permanent. Apply on Team Tailor with your LeavePlus email, not SEEK or other sites.

item.title: Staff Referral Program
item.description: Know someone who'd suit a LeavePlus role? Find out about the Referral Program on the Talent Acquisition page in the People Hub.

item.title: Seen a Colleague Living Our Values? LOVE Awards
item.description: Nominate a colleague for a LOVE Award. Past winners are listed in the Hall of Fame on the CoINVEST News site.

item.title: Got Feedback? Submit It Anytime
item.description: Share feedback through the staff feedback form and someone will be in touch.

item.title: All Staff Teams Channel - Announcements & Shoutouts
item.description: For any updates you may have missed - announcements, events and shoutouts - head to the All Staff Teams channel.
